reason: I'm a working magician, the gallery and calculator reveals already exist in free or store-bought apps I trust. I'm not typing my card into some unknown website for an app that skips the App Store.
objection: Installed from the browser, paid by card on the app's own site - if it breaks mid-show or the site disappears, my lifetime access is worth nothing and I have no store to get a refund from.
would_change_my_mind: Selling it through the App Store or Google Play, plus seeing a performer I respect use the search-reveal live on Reels and it fooling people.
